_readme: Expected fleet identity state. jlapenna/homelab's bin/emit-iam-contract-metrics.py reads this file from main and diffs it against live GitHub and GCP (docs/iam-contract.md). docs/fleet-credentials.md is the prose; change them together (#1376).
_fleetRepositoriesNote: Must stay identical to local.github_repositories in infra/terraform/main.tf - the shared 'github' WIF pool's attribute_condition is generated from it, and tools/contract-tests/iam-contract-model.test.ts asserts the two agree without needing any credentials.

githubApps._note: What the agent lanes and the console authenticate as - claims, PRs and comments land as agent-lcars[bot]. Private key: Secret Manager AGENT_LCARS_APP_PRIVATE_KEY (project agent-lcars) / repo secret AGENT_LCARS_PRIVATE_KEY.

installations._note: The maintainer chose All repositories (2026-10-12), so only the selection is asserted: a repository list would mirror the account and make every new repository drift.
The maintainer chose All repositories (2026-10-12), so only the selection is asserted: a repository list would mirror the account and make every new repository drift.
#1381 decided to narrow this installation to the three fleet repos (sprinkles, www, girosf); when that UI change happens, set repositorySelection to 'selected' and list them.

githubApps._note: What runner scale-set listeners register with. Its private key is deployed on the homelab controller for those listeners (github-runner-autoscaler/lcars-app-private-key.pem) and the collector reads it there in place, so this App is asserted from the same host with no new key distribution (jlapenna/homelab#768). It was previously modelled as unassertable on the belief that the key only existed in the ansible vault; that was wrong. It also carries actions:read (App settings UI, 2026-09-20) for the github-actions-exporter deployed on homelab: since jlapenna/agent-lcars#2024 the exporter authenticates as this App with a copy of the same key and reads /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs, which needs Actions read. Prose: docs/fleet-credentials.md ('Autoscaler App key').

_fleetCoverageNote: Every entry in fleetRepositories must be covered by some App installation. supersprinklesracing/www was found uncovered this way (#1380).
_userManagedKeyNote: No fleet service account should hold a user-managed key. The allowlists above are a ratchet: an unlisted key is a failure, and a listed account that no longer holds a key is ALSO a failure, so a retired exemption cannot be silently inherited by the next key.

agent-lcars._note: Terraform-managed by infra/terraform in this repo.

userManagedKeyAllowlist.reason: The host writer credential (Secret Manager AGENT_TELEMETRY_WRITER_KEY_JSON) is consumed by the homelab telemetry watcher outside GitHub Actions, which has no OIDC identity to federate. Every other fleet identity authenticates over WIF and must hold no key.

supersprinklesracing._note: claude-agent-pool is Terraform-managed by jlapenna/homelab (terraform/gcp_sprinkles_wif.tf, homelab#750): change its condition THERE. gcloud ... update-oidc --attribute-condition replaces rather than appends.

supersprinklesracing.svc.id.goog._note: GKE workload-identity pool, created and owned by GCP. ListWorkloadIdentityPoolProviders is not supported on it, so only its existence and state are asserted.

www-github._note: The www site-deploy provider. Created outside Terraform and undeclared until this check caught it (homelab#1497); homelab#1511 then declared it in terraform/gcp_sprinkles_wif.tf and imported it (2 imported, 0 added, 0 changed). Modelled here only because it is now managed -- adding it while it was still hand-made would have silenced a true positive rather than fixing what the check found. Deliberately narrower than claude-agent-github: one repo, one workflow file, main only, and no workflow_class mapping because nothing keys off a class.

secretIamPolicies.rationale: Exactly one binding. Two speculative accessor grants were added while chasing #1368 and pruned the same night; nothing but this check stops the next ones from persisting. The reader is claude-token-reader, impersonated by every fleet repo through the shared 'github' pool.

serviceAccountIamPolicies.rationale: The read-only Work API identity for interactive maintainer sessions (jlapenna/agent-lcars#2502). Its Console grant carries work.reader alone (the issue-owner query), and it holds no project role. Exactly one principal - the maintainer's Google account - may mint its tokens; another member would extend Console reads to that principal. Declared by google_service_account_iam_member.work_reader_token_creator in infra/terraform/main.tf.
